Class MouseEvent

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tui.event.MouseEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Event
public final class MouseEvent extends Object implements Event
Represents a mouse input event.

MouseEvent is associated with Bindings that determine how semantic actions are mapped to mouse inputs. Use the convenience methods like isClick(), isRightClick(), etc. to check if this event matches a semantic action according to the configured bindings. 

// Check semantic actions
if (event.isClick()) {
    handleClick(event.x(), event.y());
}
if (event.isRightClick()) {
    showContextMenu(event.x(), event.y());
}

// Or use explicit action matching
if (event.matches(Actions.CLICK)) {
    handleClick(event.x(), event.y());
}

// Or use custom action names
if (event.matches("myApp.contextMenu")) {
    showCustomMenu();
}
